La Habra Heights, California
No Closed Session
07:30 p.m. Regular Business
June 10, 2010
The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk's office at (562) 694-6302.
Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office at 1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.
PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
The City Council will listen to the public on any numbered item on the agenda or any item that is not on the agenda but relevant to City business. The City Council cannot legally take action on any item not scheduled on the agenda. Such items may be referred for administrative action or scheduled on a future agenda. If you wish to speak to the Council, please complete a Speaker's Card and present it before the agenda item is called. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak to the Council. Should you need to provide written documentation to the City, please give the City Manager a minimum of seven (7) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed appropriately. Comments will generally be limited to three minutes per speaker. However, a shorter limit may be declared by the Mayor for agenda items for which many Speaker Cards have been submitted.
Public Comment For Items On The Agenda: Speakers will be called on in the order cards were received.
Public Comment For Items Not On The Agenda: Persons wishing to speak on agenda items will be called at the time the agenda item is brought forward.

ANIMAL KEEPING NUISANCE PROVISIONS OF MUNICIPAL CODE RECOMMENDATIONS:
A.
Receive and file; OR
B.
Direct the City Manager to present a resolution to Council for their adoption which embodies the enforcement policies described in this staff report; OR
C.
Direct staff to prepare amendments to the Municipal Code as follows and direct the proposed modifications related to Article 7 to the Planning Commission for review and recommendation:
1.
Add to language to the definition of "small animals" in Article 7 and Article 12 along the lines of "Small animal does not include chickens, pigeons, hens and other fowl or poultry of comparable size."
2.
Add to the body of Chapter 7.10 that "Nothing in this Chapter limits or creates an exemption from Article 4.10, the general law pertaining to public and private nuisances or any other applicable law."
3.
Amend Chapter 7.3.20(B) re: permissible accessory uses in the RA zone, from "Keeping of large animals and small animals with issuance of an Animal Keeping Permit" to "Keeping of animals, provided an Animal Keeping Permit is obtained where required under Chapter 7.10." AND
D.
Eliminate the large animal keeping permit requirement in 4.10.20 for domestic animals and establish an enforceable permit process for commercial uses whether they pertain to large or small animals and with exemptions for:
a.
Residents who are classified as hobby breeders because they show their horses, roosters and/or dogs and whose emphasis is not on the sale or other commercial use of animals. (Includes FFA and 4H).
b.
Residents who raise animals for domestic meat or egg production as long as the meat and/or eggs are used only at home.
c.
Residents who raise therapy dogs or other therapy animals and/or rescue animals that are housed on a transitional basis only.
d.
Residents who raise animals as pets or for sport for their own enjoyment and who are in compliance with Articles 4 and 7 of the Municipal Code.
---------------------------------- END OF ADMINISTRATIVE ITEMS ---------------------------------
